data.description:
## Context / Problem
The d59e fix (99e22e4c2) raised the completion verifier's bounded-recovery context cap (completion_recovery.py _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS 24k -> 100k) — it applies ONLY to the close gate. Plan review has a similar-but-distinct exposure with no analog: Pass-1 container bins run at the flat DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS (16k) with no per-item output scaling (grep of passes.py/pass1.py/sizing.py shows no max_tokens/output_token_limit), while the Pass-2 verify arm already scales via output_tokens_per_item in gates/plan-review.yaml. Observed: reviewing epic a492 (17 children whose plans grew across review rounds), one container bin FAILED after 333s with UnretryableOutputError — the structured finding payload for a large bin exhausted the output ceiling; the runner correctly degrades to INDETERMINATE rather than a hollow PASS (runner.py:628-651), but the review loses the bin's coverage and the run's spend.

## Approach
Mirror the verify arm's pattern for Pass-1 container calls: scale the request's max_tokens by the bin's child count (children x per-child output reserve, floor at the default, ceiling at the model cap), threaded where the container RunRequest is built (passes.pass1_container). Alternative worth weighing: make pack_container_bins output-aware (bins sized on expected finding output, not just input tokens) — larger change, only if scaling alone proves insufficient.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py (container RunRequest max_tokens), possibly src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py (per-child reserve constant), tests/unit/workflow/ (new test asserting the scaled ceiling on a many-children fixture).

## Testing
Unit: a container bin of N children requests max_tokens = max(default, N x reserve) capped at the model limit; single-child bins unchanged; a FakeRunner fixture asserts the request field.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Container-bin RunRequests scale max_tokens by child count with floor/ceiling (checked: unit test on the request object).
- [ ] Single-child and non-container Pass-1 requests are unchanged (checked: unit test).
data.title: plan-review container bins have no output-token scaling (UnretryableOutputError on large child sets)
